scope: Selected Ring designation, word/type change and text-box exchange behavior; not complete card, rules or AI certification

engine.purpose: Separately built candidate; run catalog, pregame and interaction checks before activation

native_before.note: Identical final fixture: 39 failures and one unchanged illegal-pair positive control. Mandatory text-box exchange was skipped by the old AI registry; those baseline failures do not establish that old expiry ran.

worker_freeze.note: Both final candidate captures and the recaptured baseline postdate this freeze. Baseline was recaptured after the full candidate suite; chronological order is not used as engine identity.

versioned_rules_reference.scope: Retained versioned reference for Ring designations, progression, text replacement and duration; not a full or current rules audit

limits: Forty native cases use controlled partial four-player registrations. Paired snapshot cases cover both stack-copy modes.
Nineteen packaged witnesses pay actual costs and run bounded native phase hooks without response priority; their captured boards are controlled fixtures.
Native-only type-word and type-line cases fix the legal choice at the native controller boundary; original-game word-cache regression is also native-only.
Ring combat witnesses use controlled attacker declarations followed by native triggers, block decisions, damage and cleanup. General attacker admission is not certified.
The former-owner callback and expired word-keyword cache defects were reproduced in original games, independently of snapshot restoration.
Text exchange now has a registered basic native evaluation policy and mandatory legal-target fallback; this does not certify optimal choices or every optional Deadpool path.
Copying Ring state does not replay temptation; ordinary Clone characteristics exclude the designation while LKI retains it.
Spell-on-stack word edits, overlapping text exchanges, all Ring choices and ward patterns, player loss, hidden/merged/perpetual state and general continuations remain unverified.
Unmapped-command diagnostics are asserted for these fixtures and are not yet aggregated into normal simulation reports.

Catalog construction proves availability of scripts, not rules correctness for every card. The seven unavailable entries are nonstarting meld results. Retained rules are versioned, not a complete current-rules audit.
